figures.Fig13.4: Osmoregulation in (a) freshwater and (b) marine water (PDF page 5). Original figure archived as c12-bio-ch13-fig-13-4-fish-osmoregulation (drawn for this lesson after the printed figure; not the textbook's picture).

findings: The book says 'most marine animals are hypotonic' to sea water, but it also lists all marine invertebrates as osmoconformers (13.2.1); the lesson applies the statement to marine bony fishes, flagged.
Rectal salt glands are carried as the book prints them; they are found in sharks and rays rather than bony fishes, flagged.
